# /promptcrew-team — PromptCrew

> Backed up 2026-11-10. Call the whole team with `/promptcrew-team`; it goes to the lead.

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| Team | PromptCrew |
| Call name | `/promptcrew-team` |
| Lead | [`/bot-promptorchestrator`](../../bots/bot-promptorchestrator/README.md) |
| Members | 5 |

## Purpose

Audrey's prompt team: watch frontier prompt-tech, inventory her prompts, turn findings into revvel-standards rules, test and score prompts.

## Routing

PromptOrchestrator triages prompt requests to Promptiscuous (watch), Promptinator (inventory), PromptSteward (rules via PR into daily/YYYY-MM-DD), PromptTester (scores), then gives Audrey one plain-language summary.

## Members

| Call name | Bot | Role |
|---|---|---|
| [`/bot-promptorchestrator`](../../bots/bot-promptorchestrator/README.md) | PromptOrchestrator | PromptCrew lead; routes prompt work **(lead)** |
| [`/bot-promptiscuous`](../../bots/bot-promptiscuous/README.md) | Promptiscuous | PromptCrew frontier-prompt watcher |
| [`/bot-promptinator`](../../bots/bot-promptinator/README.md) | Promptinator | PromptCrew inventory of Audrey's existing prompts |
| [`/bot-promptsteward`](../../bots/bot-promptsteward/README.md) | PromptSteward | PromptCrew writer; turns findings into AGENTS.md rules via PRs |
| [`/bot-prompttester`](../../bots/bot-prompttester/README.md) | PromptTester | PromptCrew tester; deterministic prompt scoring |

## Rules

All members follow [BOT-COMMON-RULES.md](../../BOT-COMMON-RULES.md) plus each bot's own rules in its README.

## How to re-create the team

1. Re-create each member from its README ("How to re-create"), lead first.
2. Tell every member who the lead is and where to report.
3. Point Audrey's requests for this team at `/bot-promptorchestrator`.
